fullDescription: A premium, high-density dark mode marketplace for software assets and tech stacks. Features a brutalist-modern aesthetic with bold orange accents, high-contrast typography, and a developer-first interface. Suitable for fintech, SaaS, developer tools, and digital asset marketplaces. Key elements include a 96px bold headline, grain-textured overlays, radial glow effects, and a real-time activity sidebar.
prompt:
## Resumo
Reskyn is a developer-centric marketplace design characterized by pure black backgrounds (#000000), vibrant orange brand colors (#f97316), and a highly structured layout that balances marketing impact with information density. It uses a combination of modern sans-serif typography and glassmorphism-inspired navigation.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a pure black background (#000000). Use 'Satoshi' (Black weight) for headlines and 'General Sans' for UI elements. Primary accent color: Orange (#f97316 to #ea580c gradient). Surface cards should be #0a0a0a with a #1a1a1a border. Apply a fixed 5% opacity SVG noise/grain overlay across the entire site. Headlines must have -0.04em letter-spacing and 1.1 line-height. Include a radial background glow (rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.08)) at the top. Buttons use sharp 12px border-radius. Active elements feature a pulse animation (scale 1.2, opacity 0.5) for 'live' status indicators.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed top navigation, 80px height, background #000000 at 80% opacity with 20px backdrop-blur. Border-bottom #1a1a1a. Logo on left with 40x40px orange rounded-lg icon. Navigation links in text-zinc-400, font-size 14px, font-weight 500. Right side contains 'Join Marketplace' primary button in solid orange.

### Hero Section
Centered layout with 176px top padding. Features three floating stat badges at the top: rounded-full pills with #1a1a1a borders and pulsing green/orange status dots. Headline size is 96px, weight 900, with a gradient span 'Buy the Build' using colors #fb923c to #d97706. Subtitle is 24px zinc-400 text. Primary CTA: 56px height, orange background, bold text, with a subtle orange-950 shadow.

### Featured Grid & Sidebar
12-column grid with 40px gap. Left 8 columns: 2-column card grid for listings. Right 4 columns: Sticky sidebar containing 'Live Activity' feed and 'Trending Categories' tag cloud. Listing cards feature an aspect-ratio 16:9 thumbnail, an absolute-positioned upvote button (top-left), and a price tag (top-right).

### Trust & Footer
Trust section uses a 3-column layout with 64px vertical padding and 56x56px icon containers in low-opacity brand colors. Footer is minimalist, with a 3-way split: logo/copyright (left), text links like API/STATUS (center), and square 40px social icons (right).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Marketplace Asset Card — High-information density card for software listings.
Card container: bg #0a0a0a, border #1a1a1a, radius 12px. Hover state: translateY(-4px), border-color: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.4). Thumbnail: 60% opacity image with gradient overlay. Top-left overlay: Upvote pill (chevron + count). Top-right: Bold price tag. Content area: Title (text-xl), 2-line description (zinc-400), tech-stack tags (zinc-500, font-bold, bg-#050505), and a bottom row containing stats and dual action buttons (View Details vs Buyout).

### Live Activity Sidebar — Sticky real-time notification feed.
Container: bg #0a0a0a, border #1a1a1a, p-6, sticky positioning. Title: 'LIVE ACTIVITY' in 18px black-weight uppercase. Items: Flex-row with 40x40px circular icons (background at 10% opacity of icon color). Text: Bold user names with orange project links. Micro-detail: 10px uppercase timestamps in zinc-600.

style.description: The style is 'Brutalist-Premium'. It utilizes Satoshi for heavy, impactful headlines with tight letter-spacing and General Sans for clear, readable body text. The color palette is strictly limited to Black, Dark Gray, and Safety Orange, creating a high-energy 'build-mode' environment. Visual interest is maintained through a 5% opacity grain overlay and subtle radial glows behind the hero section.
